claims.exactBehavior: Options stages a new namespace with the exact Enter the namespace. prompt, lower/strip/trailing-colon and shared garbage cleanup, exact reserved/default and duplicate warnings, and fresh random RGB. Cancel changes neither list nor saved settings; accepted Add changes only the parent draft until Apply. Saved/reopened colours drive real media tag rows. Pending child blocks Apply, hidden owner rejects acceptance, parent Cancel retires callbacks, and retained old Cancel cannot clear a successor slot. Initial strip includes Python control-character whitespace U+001C–U+001F. Sorted Add preserves selected namespace identities while retaining numeric last-hit, Shift anchor, and range bookkeeping, as recorded for Shift/Ctrl+Shift contraction. Nested colon namespaces retain the literal namespace plus trailing-colon label (artist:inner:) and sort by that painted text. Invalid input closes Enter Text then opens an owned Warning notice with the exact message and sole OK button; acknowledgement releases the child slot, parent Apply is blocked, parent Cancel retires it, and stale question/notice callbacks cannot mutate or clear a successor.
